assertion.statement: The fixed catalogue containing the first22 primes greater than324 in every unit class modulo W exists and its ascending finite-search definition terminates.
assertion.objects: W=4 product_{p<=324}p; unit residue classes modulo W; the fixed prime catalogue and N_s.
assertion.hypotheses: W is this fixed positive integer; search is in ascending integer order with exact finite primality and congruence tests.
assertion.quantifiers: For every unit class modulo this W, the first22 qualifying primes exist.
assertion.parameter_range: Primes strictly greater than324; finitely many unit classes.
assertion.uniformity: Only the stated fixed objects and parameter range are covered; no additional uniform bound is asserted.
assertion.constants: 22 primes per class, cutoff324, modulus W.
assertion.normalizations: Discard primes<=324; take the first qualifying primes rather than an arbitrary choice.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion about non-unit classes, effective largest-prime size, all later prime searches or the M0 index.
assertion.limit_order: Fix W, enumerate its finitely many unit classes, terminate each search by infinitude, then form the fixed product.
